## What's changed

- Bounded each active Tube TV HLS session to a small rolling segment window instead of retaining every generated segment for the life of the channel.
- Removed temporary Tube TV transcode files after playback stops and protected replacement sessions from delayed cleanup.
- Added startup and periodic cleanup for abandoned Tube TV HLS directories left behind by earlier versions, crashes, or unclean shutdowns.
- Preserved active channel sessions during maintenance and added path-safety checks around automatic cleanup.
- Added regression and race coverage for rolling segment cleanup, stopped sessions, stale directories, and shared channel playback.

This is a server-side update; Tater Tube players do not need to be updated.
